mapper.sql: SELECT m.*,p.id driver_id,p.account_id,account.nickname applicant_name,d.dept_name company_name, submitter.user_name submitted_by_name,reviewer.user_name reviewed_by_name FROM vi_manual_verification m JOIN vi_driver_application a ON a.id=m.application_id JOIN vi_driver_profile p ON p.id=a.driver_id JOIN vi_account account ON account.id=p.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=m.owner_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON submitter.user_id=m.submitted_by_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.user_id=m.reviewed_by_user_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT a.id application_id,p.id driver_id,account.nickname applicant_name, p.owner_dept_id,d.dept_name company_name,a.version, p.training_context_revision company_revision,a.material_revision
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT a.id application_id,a.status,a.version,a.material_revision,a.material_hash, p.id driver_id,p.account_id,p.owner_dept_id,p.training_context_revision company_revision, (SELECT MAX(current_app.id) FROM vi_driver_application current_app WHERE current_app.driver_id=p.id) current_application_id FROM vi_driver_profile p JOIN vi_driver_application a ON a.driver_id=p.id WHERE a.id=#{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_employee_binding WHERE account_id=#{account} AND sys_user_id=#{user}
SELECT DISTINCT sys_user_id FROM vi_employee_binding WHERE account_id=#{account}
SELECT phone_lookup FROM vi_account WHERE id=#{account} AND phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT user_id,phonenumber FROM sys_user WHERE phonenumber IS NOT NULL AND phonenumber!=''
SELECT phonenumber FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{user}
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_manual_verification SET status=#{status},reviewed_by_user_id=#{reviewedByUserId},reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), review_note_cipher=#{reviewNoteCipher},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE vi_manual_verification SET proof_id=#{proof},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND proof_id IS NULL
